Avatar Generator

Generate procedural seeded SVG avatars — same seed always gives the same face. Shuffle, or download as SVG/PNG.

📖 How to use

  1. Type a seed word (or leave blank).
  2. Press Generate Avatar (or Shuffle).
  3. Download as SVG or PNG.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How are avatars made?

A seeded random generator picks face shapes, skin tones, hair, eyes, mouths, and accessories — fully procedural, no images.

Are they reproducible?

Yes — type any seed word and the same avatar is generated every time.

What can I download?

Download the vector SVG or a raster PNG (512×512).

What does Shuffle do?

Shuffle rolls a random seed for a brand-new face.
